work.name: Meta
work.x-op-workDescHtml:
• Built three field types for an internal data table platform in React and TypeScript
  • Optimized virtual scrolling for 10K-row tables, raising the frame rate from 32fps to 58fps
  • Added 12 unit tests to the shared component library and fixed 5 UI defects
  • Took part in requirement and code reviews, landing 20+ changes by team conventions

work.name: Stripe
work.x-op-workDescHtml:
• Shipped six ECharts-based analytics widgets for the merchant dashboard
  • Cut dashboard LCP from 3.2s to 1.6s with route-level code splitting and parallel data fetching
  • Wrote usage docs and component examples that three other teams reused

projects.name: Real-Time Collaborative Document Editor
projects.description: Senior capstone: a multi-user document editor with rich text editing, comments and version history
projects.x-op-projectContentHtml:
• Built a rich text editing core on ProseMirror supporting 20+ block types and common inline styles

  • Integrated the Yjs CRDT engine for concurrent editing, cursor sync and automatic conflict merging

  • Designed WebSocket reconnection and local draft caching, losing zero edits on unstable networks

projects.name: Campus Marketplace
projects.description: A second-hand marketplace for university students covering listing, search, checkout and chat
projects.x-op-projectContentHtml:
• Delivered 18 pages and 30+ components, integrating OAuth login, payments and push notifications

  • Implemented paged product feeds and lazy-loaded images, keeping first paint under 800ms

  • Reached 2,000+ registered users and 300+ daily actives; selected for a university innovation grant

projects.name: Algorithm Visualizer
projects.description: An interactive visualizer that animates common data structures and algorithms step by step
projects.x-op-projectContentHtml:
• Implemented animated walkthroughs and single-step debugging for 12 algorithms on Canvas

  • Designed execution snapshots with seek and playback-speed controls

  • Open sourced on GitHub with 120+ stars; used as a teaching demo in a campus algorithms course
